evidenceNotes: Punjab state recruitment register displays one DGM (Technical) Cyber Security row under Department of Good Governance and Information Technology with closing date 8 October 2026 and detailed/newspaper PDFs. DGG&IT homepage lists the same two PDFs. Both hosts' corresponding PDF bytes are identical and pinned by SHA-256.

Detailed advertisement 02/2026 page 1 says one Deputy General Manager (Technical) Cyber Security two-year initial contract under Punjab State e-Governance Society, renewable annually subject to performance and need, gross remuneration ₹1,25,000 monthly.

Page 1 requires B.E./B.Tech/B.Sc (IT, Computer Science or Electronics) or BCA with at least 50% from recognized institution and 13 years relevant cyber security experience. MBA/PGDM/PGDBM/PGP in management is preferred, not mandatory. Maximum age 42 on 1 August 2026.

Working knowledge of Punjabi is essential. Candidates without Punjabi at Matric must pass a Punjabi test equivalent to Matric standard within six months from appointment, or at the next available exam if none is held then. No CEFR level or pre-appointment test deadline is stated.

Page 2 requires non-refundable ₹2,000 RTGS fee and online application by 8 October 2026 at 11:59 PM IST. Original notice directs applicants to a Google Form and payment account; pending draft links to the official PDF instead of publishing off-domain payment/form instructions before founder review. No application opening date is printed.

Nationality and foreign-citizen appointment permission are not stated. Mohali office address is an authority address, not a published examination or interview venue. Notice warns of possible deferment/cancellation but does not itself announce either.
